args.command: echo '=== THERMAL ZONES ==='; for z in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*; do [ -r "$z/type" ] || continue; printf '%s=' "$(cat "$z/type" 2>/dev/null)"; cat "$z/temp" 2>/dev/null || true; done; echo '=== HWMON ==='; for h in /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon*; do [ -d "$h" ] || continue; printf 'HWMON %s ' "$h"; cat "$h/name" 2>/dev/null || true; find "$h" -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name 'temp*_input' -o -name 'fan*_input' \) -printf '%f=' -exec cat {} \; 2>/dev/null | head -20; done; echo '=== SENSORS CMD ==='; command -v sensors || true; sensors 2>/dev/null | head -80 || true; echo '=== DRM ==='; ls -1 /sys/class/drm 2>/dev/null | head -40; for c in /sys/class/drm/card*/device; do [ -d "$c" ] || continue; echo DEVICE=$c; find "$c" -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name 'gpu_busy_percent' -o -name 'gt_cur_freq_mhz' -o -name 'gt_max_freq_mhz' \) -print -exec cat {} \; 2>/dev/null | head -30; done; echo '=== GPU TOOLS ==='; command -v intel_gpu_top || true; command -v nvidia-smi || true; echo '=== NETWORK ==='; ip -br link 2>/dev/null || true; cat /proc/net/dev 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== UPTIME ==='; cat /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null || true

meta.summary: Read-only discover Mini telemetry sources for Living Visualizer system panel
